title: Ring
description: An ordered rollout cohort pointing at a profile.

order.description: Position in the rollout; earliest ring has the lowest order. Must be unique.

profile.description: Name of the Profile applied to members.

release.description: Immutable published release digest to pin to; empty builds from the profile.

users.description: Explicit user ids always in this ring; checked before groups. A user may appear in only one ring.

groups.description: IdP groups always in this ring.

percent.description: Percent of remaining users hashed into this ring (0-100, 0.01 precision).

default.description: Marks the catch-all (GA) ring. Exactly one ring must set this.

optIn.description: Developers may join this ring themselves from the portal (recorded as a group membership request; admins may auto-approve).
